evidence: Fresh Supabase API source download; inspected without calling customer report or mutation endpoints
finding: revoke_token updates only id plus created_by; it does not check current academy membership or verify that a row was actually revoked
consequences: An active replacement academy owner cannot revoke a prior issuer's report link, but receives success when no row changes
A still-signed-in former issuer can revoke a link after losing academy authority
requiredCorrection: Authorize against the token's stored academy and current appropriate report-management capability
Keep authorization and revocation in one database transaction with concurrent demotion/closure checks
Preserve valid public report reads, scope and revoked/expired behavior
Preserve downloaded runtime dependencies and verify_jwt=false for the public read endpoint
Qualify solely with exclusively owned academy/report fixtures and no customer report access
